evidence_text: Q: How did Vladimir Komarov die? A: On April 24th, 1967 Space claimed its first victim. Soviet cosmonaut Vladimir Komarov crashed into the ground when the main parachute on his Soyuz 1 descent capsule failed to open. He became the first cosmonaut to fly into space twice and the first man to die while on a space mission (Apollo 1 tragedy happened 3 months earlier during the ground test). [SEP] Q: Were Vladimir Komarov remains found? A: Yes Explanation: Komarov's charred remains were uncovered and displayed during his funeral. The largest recognizable part of his body was his heel bone.
